# Rayito de Sol

> > Rayito de Sol offers Spanish immersion daycare and early learning programs with STEAM-based curriculum across multiple locations in Illinois and Minnesota.

Rayito de Sol is a bilingual early childhood education provider specializing in Spanish immersion programs for infants through kindergarten. The organization operates multiple locations in the Chicago area and Minneapolis-Richfield region, emphasizing intercultural education, language development, and STEAM learning.

## Key Topics

- Spanish immersion
- Bilingual education
- Early childhood education
- STEAM curriculum
- Daycare programs
- Preschool
- Language development
- Cultural learning
- Infant programs
- Toddler programs
- Kindergarten preparation
- Social-emotional learning
- Multilingual education
- Child development
- NAEYC accreditation

## Core Programs

- [Spanish Immersion Programs](https://www.rayitoschools.com/programs): Overview of Rayito de Sol's Spanish immersion daycare and preschool programs
- [Spanish Immersion Infant Program](https://www.rayitoschools.com/infant-preschool-program): Spanish immersion infant program for ages 6 weeks-16 months with language development
- [Spanish Immersion Toddler Program](https://www.rayitoschools.com/toddler-daycare-program): Spanish immersion toddler program with bilingual language and motor development
- [Spanish Immersion Preschool and Daycare Program](https://www.rayitoschools.com/preschool-and-daycare-programs): Spanish immersion preschool for ages 3-5 with STEAM curriculum and bilingual focus
- [Spanish Immersion Kindergarten Program](https://www.rayitoschools.com/kinder-prep-program): Spanish immersion kindergarten for ages 5-6 with bilingual foundation and STEAM
- [Spanish Immersion Summer Camp Program](https://www.rayitoschools.com/summer-camps-for-kids): Spanish immersion summer camp for ages 6 weeks-7 years in Minneapolis-Richfield
